Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, indeed I am needy of You
And I am fearful of Your punishment, seeking Your protection
O Allah, do not change my name
And do not transform my body
And do not intensify my afflictions
And do not let my enemies rejoice at my misfortune
I seek refuge in Your forgiveness from Your punishment
And I seek refuge in Your mercy from Your torment
And I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your displeasure
And I seek refuge in You from You
You are as You have praised Yourself
And above what any speaker can express
